get_np_range_info: get the min and max range info for a numpy dtype like float32 or uint32
get_tensor_spec_bounds: get the inclusive min and max bounds from a dm_env_rpc TensorSpec protobuf message
set_tensor_spec_bounds: set the minimum and maximum bounds on a dm_env_rpc TensorSpec protobuf message
validate_bound_for_dtype: validate whether a scalar or array value is safely castable to a given numpy dtype
create_bounds_dataclass: create a Bounds dataclass instance with min and max values for a tensor spec
